name: frontend-development-plugin
description: Wonchang's frontend development harness for Claude Code — modular plugins for code rules, API scaffolding, and more.

plugins.name: seokit-rules
plugins.description: Enforce React/TypeScript code conventions from CODE_RULES.md via auto-invoked skill, /code-review command, and seokit-reviewer subagent. Drives all enforcement from §3 MUST rules + §5 agent contract.

plugins.name: seokit-api
plugins.description: OpenAPI-driven API module scaffolding for openapi-typescript + TanStack Query projects. Detects project conventions and surgically applies generated diffs to domain api/types/queryKeys/queries files. Preserves human-authored code.
